package lesson

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteLessonInput holds input values.
type DeleteLessonInput struct {
	LessonID string
}

// DeleteLesson removes lesson (cascades to tasks).
type DeleteLesson struct {
	Lessons repository.LessonRepository
}

// Handle performs deletion.
func (uc DeleteLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, in DeleteLessonInput) error {
	if _, err := uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, in.LessonID); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	return uc.Lessons.Delete(ctx, in.LessonID)
}
